title: Segment lookup after a list head
statement: Let a segment be a pair consisting of a Boolean list and a Boolean. For any segment $s$, list of segments $R$, and natural number $i$, looking up position $i+1$ in the list $s :: R$ returns the same segment as looking up position $i$ in $R$.
